input.summary: Start a safe 1-2-3 mode before completing C-O-N-C-R-E-T-E, then use multiball to alternate the center-lane Jackpot and upper-flipper U-Turn Super.

quickInfo.name: C-O-N-C-R-E-T-E
quickInfo.summary: BED, ROCK, first-multiball DIG, and Bronto Crane awards spot letters; completing the word lights multiball.

quickInfo.name: Mode stack
quickInfo.summary: Complete 1-2-3 on the lit ramps before multiball; running modes continue during multiball.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: The center lane collects the regular Jackpot and feeds the upper flipper.

quickInfo.name: Super Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: After the center collect, shoot the U-Turn from the upper flipper; it relights the center Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Drain Shield
quickInfo.summary: Complete either shell-target bank to light temporary outlane rescue.

steps.text: Test the ramps, center lane, U-Turn, BED targets, ROCK targets, and orbit-to-Time-Machine feed.
Complete the lit 1-2-3 ramp sequence to start a mode whose shots overlap the main route.
Build C-O-N-C-R-E-T-E through the safer BED or ROCK bank and any available Bronto Crane spotting.
Shoot a lit orbit, or complete DIG where applicable, to start three-ball multiball.
Shoot the center lane for the regular Jackpot and prepare for its feed to the upper flipper.
Use the upper flipper to shoot the U-Turn Super Jackpot, which relights the center-lane Jackpot.
Repeat the center-to-U-Turn cycle while using the running mode's overlapping lit shots.
Between starts, complete a shell bank for Drain Shield before attacking the central target areas.

fallback.title: Dino Frenzy
fallback.when: Use this when ramp transfers and C-O-N-C-R-E-T-E banks reject but the Dino targets are safe.

steps.text: Complete 1-2-3 until Dino Frenzy is selected.
Start the two-ball mode.
Repeat controlled lit Dino targets, using the Dino-marked target to raise the value.

alternatives.title: Bronto Crane spot
alternatives.when: Use this when the left orbit is reliable and direct BED or ROCK hits are dangerous.

steps.text: Shoot the left orbit to light Bronto Crane.
Shoot it again for the diverted award.
Take Spell CONCRETE when awarded, then start multiball from the safest lit route.

alternatives.title: Bowl-A-Rama multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when two strikes are already recorded and the ramp-to-bowling feed is consistent.

steps.text: Shoot the lit Go Bowling ramp.
Make the center strike target; use Bowling Power-Up when available.
After the third strike, take Super Strikes during two-ball play.
Play all four 1-2-3 modes.
Start Mystery Mode on the next completed sequence.
Knock down BED and ROCK inside the timer for the completion award.

techniques.name: Mode-before-multiball order
techniques.instruction: Finish the lit 1-2-3 sequence before starting multiball so the selected mode continues under protection.

techniques.name: Center-to-U-Turn transfer
techniques.instruction: After the center Jackpot, prepare the upper flipper immediately for the U-Turn Super feed.

cautions.issue: The center lane and drop-bank rebounds can drain straight down the middle.
cautions.response: Use multiball or Drain Shield protection for repeated center work.

cautions.issue: The ramp transfer can unexpectedly switch the receiving flipper.
cautions.response: Read the 1-2-3 lights and keep both flippers ready until the ball commits to the loop.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm ROM, CONCRETE spotting, mode order, and ball saves.
Test the center lane, U-Turn, ramps, and orbit gate.
input.simpleOverview: Any of The Flintstones' four 1-2-3 modes can continue during C-O-N-C-R-E-T-E Multiball. Start a mode through its three lit ramps, finish CONCRETE, then collect the center-lane Jackpot and use its upper-flipper feed for the U-Turn Super before repeating the cycle.
input.overview: Any of The Flintstones' four 1-2-3 modes can continue during C-O-N-C-R-E-T-E Multiball. Begin a compatible 1-2-3 mode, finish CONCRETE through safe BED, ROCK, and spotting progress, then start Multiball. Alternate the center Jackpot and upper-flipper U-Turn Super while the mode's overlapping shots remain active.
